description: The lighter Inkling: a 276B-total / 12B-active MoE that matches its larger sibling on many benchmarks at a quarter of the size, with the same native text/image/audio reasoning and variable thinking effort. Open weights on Hugging Face, sold through Tinker serverless inference at $0.30/$1.20 per 1M tokens.
price_note: Tinker Serverless Inference (Beta) list price for the 256K-context nvfp4 sampling endpoint. OpenRouter lists this model's input at $0.50/1M — 67% over the vendor's own published rate — so the first-party figure is the one published here.

description: Meta's first proprietary, paid-API model and the flagship of the new Meta Model API — a multimodal agentic model with a 1M-token context that takes text, image, video, audio and PDF input. Built for tool calling, computer use and coding. $1.25/$4.25 per 1M tokens, with cached input at $0.15. Unlike Llama, it is API-only: there are no open weights.
price_note: Meta Model API list price, per 1M tokens, with no long-context premium. Search grounding is billed separately at $2.50 per 1,000 queries and is not included in the token rate. Public preview was US-only at launch.

description: Meta's current flagship on the Meta Model API and the direct successor to Muse Spark 1.1 — a multimodal agentic model with a 1M-token context that takes text, image, video, audio and PDF input, retrained for coding, whole-repository work and computer use. $1.25/$4.25 per 1M tokens, with cached input at $0.15 — the same list price as Muse Spark 1.1. Like 1.1 it is API-only: there are no open weights.
price_note: Meta Model API standard-tier list price, per 1M tokens, with no long-context premium — the tier on which Meta states prompts and completions are not used for training. A cheaper contributor tier ($0.10 input / $0.20 output per 1M) trades training rights and a far lower rate limit (60 vs 3,000 requests/min) for the discount, so it is not the tracked list price. Search grounding is billed separately per 1,000 queries and is not included in the token rate.

description: Sakana AI's frontier orchestration model — a multi-agent system served as a single OpenAI-compatible model that routes each request across a pool of expert LLMs, including recursive calls to itself. Pricing is context-tiered rather than flat: $5.00/$30.00 per 1M tokens at or below 272K context with cached input at $0.50, rising to $10 / $45 / $1.00 above 272K. One fixed rate covers both fugu-ultra-v1.1 and fugu-ultra-v1.0.
price_note: Sakana AI Token Plan (pay-as-you-go) list price, per 1M tokens. The published rate is CONTEXT-TIERED, not flat: the tracked $5.00 input, $30.00 output and $0.50 cached input apply at or below 272K context, and the vendor lists $10 input, $45 output and $1.00 cached above it — so a long-context request bills at 2x the tracked input rate and 1.5x the tracked output rate. The monthly subscription tiers (Standard $20, Pro $100, Max $200) bundle usage allowances rather than per-token rates and are not the list price. Sibling SKUs are deliberately not tracked here: plain Fugu has no fixed rate of its own (it bills at the standard rate of whichever underlying model it routes to) and Fugu Cyber is contact-sales. Sakana states the service is not offered to users in EU or EEA member states.

description: Sakana AI's Japanese-specialised LLM API — built on Moonshot AI's open Kimi K2.6 and adapted with Sakana's in-house data for Japanese language and Japanese business context, with built-in web search and code execution and an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. $0.95/$4.00 per 1M tokens with cached input at $0.15.
price_note: Sakana AI Token Plan (pay-as-you-go) list price, per 1M tokens, read on the vendor's own console pricing page (input $0.95, cached input $0.15, output $4.00) and corroborated by Sakana's product page sakana.ai/namazu/ at the same figures; OpenRouter matches exactly. Unlike the tracked Fugu Ultra row the published Namazu rate is FLAT — Sakana lists no context tier for it. Billing is per token only and Namazu is excluded from Sakana's subscription plans. description: Upstage's current flagship Solar LLM — a 102B-parameter mixture-of-experts model activating 12B parameters per token, tuned for reasoning, instruction following and bilingual Korean/English work, and updated in March 2026 for agentic use. $0.15/$0.60 per 1M tokens with cached input at $0.015. description: Upstage's agentic Solar flagship, successor to Solar Pro 3, with a 512K context window and up to 128K output tokens. Launch pricing is $0.03/$0.12 per 1M tokens (90% off) through Sep 10 2026; it reverts to Upstage's standard list price of $0.30/$1.20 on Sep 11 2026.

description: Relace's code-retrieval specialist, released as Fast Agentic Search — a subagent trained with reinforcement learning that fires view, grep and bash calls in parallel to explore several file chains at once, then reports back the minimal set of files a coding agent needs as context. $1.00/$3.00 per 1M tokens.
price_note: Relace's own pricing page list price, per 1M tokens; OpenRouter quotes the same $1.00/$3.00. Relace publishes no cached-input rate for this model. description: Relace's code-merge specialist — a fast-apply model that takes the lazy diff a frontier model emits and merges it back into the existing file at over 10,000 tokens per second, so the expensive model never has to regenerate unchanged code. $0.80/$1.20 per 1M tokens.
price_note: Relace's own pricing page list price, per 1M tokens. OpenRouter serves the same model at $0.85 input / $1.25 output — a host markup of about 6% over the maker's list — and we publish the maker's rate. Relace publishes no cached-input rate for this model.
